comparison_scope: Bundled indexed-supervisor ablation; not an isolated test of compact hints, exact-ID retrieval, minification, autoencoder quality, or proof discharge.

actual_execution: supervisor goal/subgoal/task planning receipt and completion state
full index hydration/catalog/world records and no-index explicit absence
actual compact numerical summary, source function coverage, pending/discharged counts, actual exact-ID or filtered/fullscan retrieval counts including zero
Source384 selected/load/inference/unsupported outcome distinct from deterministic grammar
declared output candidate/canonical hashes from the repaired observer, including unavailable reason/stage
official benchmark reward and verifier aggregate only
setup, preparation, planning, coding, cleanup and total elapsed time
all retained failures, cancellations and attempts
controls: current repository commits and source hashes
runtime archive/manifest digests and asset verification
task profile/public input hashes plus complete task identity hashes without hidden contents
allowed config diff audit and preparation hashes
route metadata readiness and any rejected preflights
privacy: Keep raw prompts, transcripts, copied credentials, session descriptors, signing material, databases and worker/private-owner state local.
Publish only reviewed content-free aggregate receipts, command recipes and source/asset hashes.
token_accounting: Sum each distinct provider invocation once; retain planning and coding subtotals.
Use final cumulative provider token counters rather than summing cumulative stream snapshots.
Report input, cached input, output and total; cached input is a subset of input and must not be added twice.
Keep raw prompt/metadata byte counts separate from actual billed/token counters.
If model usage is unavailable, mark unavailable; never infer tokens from text bytes.

forbidden_inferences: A byte reduction is not a token saving.
Pending structural obligations and Lean compilation do not discharge numerical or algorithmic correctness.
Four-function structural coverage does not imply the Source384 scalar decoder supports four functions.
A one-task one-attempt pair cannot establish statistical or causal generality.
This is not a native Codex harness baseline; both arms use the supervisor and the llm_router.
No selected Intent384 checkpoint means the Intent path remains fail-open; this is not a fully trained multi-IR experiment.

history.previous_comparison: Both arms full; legacy versus common-bindings@1 metadata projection, identity@1 source reader, ordinary-completion@1 coding reply. That pair is not the present no-index baseline.

question: For this one fresh task pair, what are measured total provider tokens, reward, preparation cost and elapsed time for the current indexed supervisor bundle versus its no-index ablation?
release_gates: Freeze one matching provider profile after the repeated metadata readiness gate.
Build a new runtime with current P/D/K; verify archive and manifest digests, source closure, checkpoint/embedding/Lean/extension bindings.
Retain producer source hashes before and after both trials; no producer edits mid-pair.
Prepare both arms before launch, with identical public inputs, task hashes, assets, resource budget and provider profile.
Independently diff generated configs and preparations; only listed config paths may differ, aside from expected integrity digests over those differences.
Verify full preparation advertises v3 and matching source384; no-index has the same requested profile/assets and explicitly disabled consumption.
Keep no Intent384 selection, no target training, no learned numerical selector, no ordinary-completion reply, no metadata projection/source-view/setup-cache extras.
Start each trial from its own fresh task container and output directory; do not feed first-arm plans/results/edits into the second.
Run to the existing fixed budget; retain setup/preflight/model failures and all attempts. No asymmetric extension, patch or retry.
Collect final official reward, provider usage, output observation, cleanup and integrity receipts from both before drawing conclusions.

route_selection.rule: Select one route after metadata-only readiness and freeze it for both arms. Preserve rejected preflights separately. No implicit provider fallback within a prepared pair; if a later route change is necessary, retain failed attempts and create a fresh complete pair.

setup_policy: Normal native provider installation in both fresh trials. Retained public npm tarballs are verified but no shared qualified install-cache integration is selected. Do not add full-only page-cache advice or silently preinstall one arm. Record provider/package setup latency separately from agent and preparation timing.
source384_expected_limit: Pinned parent checkpoint is matched to prior assets; previous source384 inference yielded four unsupported learned source contracts. The independent deterministic v3 frontend supports four function structures and retains unresolved obligations; record the new actual receipt rather than assuming the old outcome.
